findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Not done. The new filter removes self only from scope blockers. A task whose After entry is its qualified name, such as SHOP/SAVE, still gets itself from the prerequisite calculation. Story parsing accepts that entry because cycle detection skips qualified names. `forge next --json` then includes SHOP/SAVE in that part's `waits_for`, so the Done-when condition is unmet.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Test. Both named proof cases search the JSON output for the prose phrase `SHOP/SAVE waits for SHOP/SAVE`. A JSON `waits_for` entry containing SHOP/SAVE would never contain that phrase, so both tests would pass with the machine output listing the part as its own dependency. The proof does not check the JSON behavior it invokes.
